# Issue 3872. One source, five compiles; each isolates one SemanticInterpretation
# table cell so a per-block regex can attribute the signature row it produces.
# Line 1 is the SELF-TEST (VSOut -- the position the VRS spec permits).
# Lines 2-5 are the four positions the issue says should be NA.
# 6_4 is the oldest shader model that can express SV_ShadingRate (the table
# gates every ShadingRate cell on `_64`), so this is the oldest profile that
# can show the symptom.
-T vs_6_4 -E VSMain repro.hlsl
-T hs_6_4 -E HSCPInMain repro.hlsl
-T hs_6_4 -E HSCPOutMain repro.hlsl
-T ds_6_4 -E DSCPInMain repro.hlsl
-T ds_6_4 -E DSOutMain repro.hlsl
